mainEntity.name: How do you confirm a 2.0 Mpi engine fits my Discovery 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: We check the engine number, VIN and registration, then compare the sump, mounts, ancillaries and engine management with the replacement. T16 engines from Rover cars can differ, so compatibility is confirmed before supply.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 2.0 Mpi engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and availability.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a 2.0 Mpi engine for my own mechanic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery 1 2.0 Mpi engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, parts availability, the condition of your current engine, any cooling or ancillary parts needed and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 2.0 Mpi engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Land Rover engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 2.0 Mpi engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine and parts availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
